name: record_interpretation
arguments: {"test_id": "T2", "per_hypothesis": [{"id": "H1", "verdict": "unchanged", "why": "Agent-generated hypothesis (PH-TH dimer interface). T2 measures folding stability, not inter-chain contacts, so it does not bear on the dimer interface. The interface check (T3) is still not_covered for residue 28."}, {"id": "H2", "verdict": "unchanged", "why": "Agent-generated hypothesis (inositol phosphate binding). T2 does not measure ligand contact. Its FoldX value (-0.76 kcal/mol for R28H) is a stability result and neither supports nor refutes H2. H2 keeps the direct support from T1 (E20, E21): residue 28 within 4.5 \u00c5 of an organic ligand in 32 of 39 structures, closest 2.58 \u00c5 to 4PT."}, {"id": "H3", "verdict": "weakened", "why": "Agent-generated hypothesis (fold destabilisation). The predicted FoldX change for R28H is -0.755 kcal/mol, below the 2.0 kcal/mol destabilising threshold, at residue pLDDT 94.31 (applicability met). The within-site controls gave R28C -0.17 and R28L -1.57 kcal/mol, so R28H is not a standout destabiliser. The refute criterion was not fully met: the value is near zero but within FoldX error of about 1 kcal/mol, and no MD or buried-contact check was run, so H3 is weakened, not refuted."}], "uncertainty": "T2 is a computational FoldX prediction on the AlphaFold model, not a measurement. Its error is about 1 kcal/mol, so -0.76 kcal/mol is not clearly neutral. A neutral result does not show the variant is tolerated. Controls: the pLDDT applicability check passed (94.31), and the within-site comparison ranks R28L as more stabilising than R28H, which is a relative result only. No compute job ran (job_id null), and MM/PBSA or MD was not run. T2 does not separate H1 from H2. The H2 direct evidence still comes from T1, a correlational contact survey across structures, not a mutant-specific binding measurement. The C-alpha and ligand-contact results were not checked against R28H itself, and no structure carries R28H. Validation still needed: a mutant-specific binding or docking test for R28H versus wild type, and an interface check for H1 from a source that covers residue 28."}

name: record_decision
arguments: {"favoured_after": "H2", "why": "Previous favourite H2 (agent-generated hypothesis, inositol phosphate binding) is kept. Its direct support is T1 (E20, E21): residue 28 lies within 4.5 \u00c5 of an organic ligand in 32 of 39 ligand-bound structures, closest 2.58 \u00c5 to 4PT (2Z0P) and 2.75 \u00c5 to 4IP (1BWN). Negative-control ligands never contacted the residue, and H2's refute criterion was not met. T2 did not address H2, so H2 gained nothing from it. The strongest rival is H3 (agent-generated hypothesis, fold destabilisation).
